parts.text:
Set up the Go module `github.com/example/fluentmap` with a fluent `map[string]interface{}` wrapper. All tests pass, `gofmt`/`go vet` clean.

Files:
- `go.mod`
- `map.go`: `New`, `From`, chainable `Set`/`SetDefault`/`Delete`/`Clear`/`Merge`/`MergeDeep`, plus `Clone`, `Pick`, `Omit`, `Filter`, `Each`, `Keys`, `Has`.
- `access.go`: typed getters (`GetString`, `GetInt`, `GetFloat64`, `GetBool`, `GetSlice`, `GetStrings`, `GetMap`) and path variants.
- `path.go`: dot/bracket path access — `GetPath`, `SetPath`, `DeletePath`, `HasPath` (e.g. `list[0].name`, `matrix[1][0]`).
- `convert.go`: flexible, lossless conversions (JSON numbers, numeric strings, typed slices via reflection).
- `json.go`: `Parse`, `MarshalJSON`/`UnmarshalJSON`, `Decode`, `String`.
- `map_test.go`: coverage of all of the above.

Example:
```go
m := fluentmap.New().Set("name", "gopher").SetPath("address.city", "Berlin")
city, _ := m.GetPathString("address.city") // "Berlin"
```

Run with `go test ./...`. Want me to add a README or a specific module path?
